description: This file is the __init__.py for the 'mtia' package within torch, providing an interface to the MTIA backend including device management, stream control, RNG state, and memory profiling.

classes.name: device
classes.description: Context-manager that changes the selected device.

classes.name: StreamContext
classes.description: Context-manager that selects a given stream for MTIA kernels within its context.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialize the MTIA subsystem.

methods.name: is_initialized
methods.description: Check if MTIA has been initialized.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Check if MTIA device is available.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Wait for all jobs on a MTIA device to complete.

methods.name: device_count
methods.description: Get number of MTIA devices available.

methods.name: current_device
methods.description: Get index of the current device.

methods.name: current_stream
methods.description: Get current stream for a device.

methods.name: default_stream
methods.description: Get default stream for a device.

methods.name: record_memory_history
methods.description: Enable/disable memory profiling on MTIA allocator.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Get a snapshot of MTIA memory allocator history.

methods.name: attach_out_of_memory_observer
methods.description: Attach an OOM observer.

methods.name: is_bf16_supported
methods.description: Check if bfloat16 is supported.

methods.name: get_device_capability
methods.description: Get device capability as (major, minor).

methods.name: empty_cache
methods.description: Empty MTIA device cache.

methods.name: set_stream
methods.description: Set current stream for a device.

methods.name: set_device
methods.description: Set current device.

methods.name: get_device_properties
methods.description: Get properties of a device.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Context manager to temporarily change device.

methods.name: StreamContext
methods.description: Context manager for stream selection.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Wraps StreamContext for stream management.

methods.name: get_rng_state
methods.description: Get RNG state of a device.

methods.name: get_rng_state_all
methods.description: Get RNG states of all devices.

methods.name: set_rng_state
methods.description: Set RNG state of a device.

methods.name: set_rng_state_all
methods.description: Set RNG states for all devices.

methods.name: manual_seed
methods.description: Set seed for current device.

methods.name: manual_seed_all
methods.description: Set seed for all devices.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Get a seed for current device.

methods.name: seed_all
methods.description: Get a seed for all devices.

methods.name: initial_seed
methods.description: Get current seed of current device.
